seen.where: ASTo seal database records sigdtl did=490 and did=1197 (read by curl with the asto_v cookie, 6 Nov 2026) and ASTo inventory n. 102, Matrimoni della Real Casa, mazzo 25 fasc. 4 (inventari id=484745); the letters are not digitised (fonds marked 'Digitalizzato: No')
seen.extent: Two received letters, 16 Oct 1612 and 21 Jul 1613, each sealed with Charles Emmanuel I's seal (red wax under paper), in mazzo 25 fasc. 7; fasc. 4 of the same mazzo holds 'Lettere diverse' of the duke, Cardinal Maurizio and Prince Tommaso to Gabaleone, 1612-1619; length of the cipher not known
seen.cipher: Both seal-database records are titled "Lettera cifrata di Carlo Emanuele I duca di Savoia indirizzata a Giovanni Battista Gabaleone ambasciatore a Londra", file title "Matrimonio progettato tra l'Infanta Maria figlia del duca Carlo Emanuel I di Savoia ed il principe di Galles Enrico Federico". The seal photo shows the seal and a strip of the sheet only, so the cipher system and whether Gabaleone wrote a decipherment on the received letters cannot be told from the record; to be settled from scans.

searches.query: Gabaleone ambasciatore Londra 1612 lettere cifra Carlo Emanuele I matrimonio principe Enrico
searches.result: BL Add MS 32023 A-B catalogue, CSP Venice vol. 12-13 entries on Gabaleone (Prince Henry's death, his 1613 marriage instructions) and the Ben Jonson 'Turin' pages; nothing on the duke's cipher letters to him or any decipherment of them.

searches.query: "Matrimoni della Real Casa" mazzo 25 Gabaleone Inghilterra principe di Galles Maria di Savoia 1612 studio
searches.result: Pointed to the Unito paper 'Le missioni del conte di Cartignano (1611-1612). Un progetto di matrimonio inglese per il Principe di Piemonte' (PDF on iris.unito.it refused curl and WebFetch with a bot wall) and BL Add MS 4149 discourse; no edition of mazzo 25 letters found.

searches.query: cifra Carlo Emanuele I duca di Savoia cifrario ambasciatori decifrazione studio crittografia sabauda
searches.result: No study of Charles Emmanuel I's diplomatic ciphers; only biographies and unrelated Neapolitan/imperial cipher papers in Estudios Romanicos.

searches.query: Gabaleone Varallo OR Raviola OR Bianchi ambasciatore sabaudo Inghilterra Giacomo I studio carteggio
searches.result: A Petrolini chapter on diplomatic correspondence between Sarpi and James I (title cut off), Raviola/Varallo's Gli spazi sabaudi, Bianchi's Turin and the British (18th c.); none prints or deciphers the 1612-13 letters. The uvic.ca Jonson page quotes a Gabaleone despatch of 9 Jan 1620 (Lettere Ministri GB m. 3) whose cipher passage carries the decipherment written above it.

prior_art.decode: known.py on Gabaleone, Matrimoni della Real Casa, mazzo 25, Carlo Emanuele I, Charles Emmanuel, 32023 (harvested DECODE views dumps and repo ledgers): only this lead's own rows and the Turin sweep; no DECODE record for any Savoyard letter to Gabaleone.
prior_art.tomokiyo: Web search 'cryptiana Tomokiyo Savoy cipher Duke of Savoy 17th century nomenclator' found no Cryptiana article on a Savoyard cipher of Charles Emmanuel I; nearest is a 1556 Emmanuel Philibert-Renard cipher paper in Estudios Romanicos.
prior_art.lasry: Local GL.htm (targets/esp318/lit/crypt/GL.htm) has Savoy only for a 1593 Savoyard ambassador's letters in BnF Esp. 318; nothing on Gabaleone. Web search on Lasry/HistoCrypt Savoy ciphers found no Savoyard paper.
prior_art.edition: No edition of the duke's letters to Gabaleone found. Carutti, Storia della diplomazia della corte di Savoia vol. 2 (1876, archive.org djvu text grepped) only summarises the double Stuart marriage project (Cambiano di Ruffia, then Gabaleone); Ricotti, Storia della monarchia piemontese vol. 4 cites Gabaleone instructions for Switzerland and France, not mazzo 25; CSP Venice vol. 12-13 give Venetian reports only. BL Add MS 32023 A-B are 19th-century transcripts of the envoys' despatches 'with their instructions, etc.' 1611-14 (not online): they may include ducal letters and were not opened.
prior_art.literature: No literature on these cipher letters found. Orrell (1979) and the Jonson Turin pages use Gabaleone's own despatches; the Cartignano paper (Unito) is on the 1611-12 Piedmont match and could not be downloaded (bot wall).

2360.key_check: No Savoyard key of 1612-13 is held here or on DECODE. The received letters may carry Gabaleone's interlinear decipherment, and his own despatches in ASTo Lettere Ministri Gran Bretagna m. 1-3 are deciphered above the line in Turin (1620 example), which would give the cipher; none tested, nothing seen.
2360.key_held: None held. Candidate key material: deciphered Gabaleone despatches, ASTo Lettere Ministri, Gran Bretagna, mazzi 1-3 (1612-20), not online, not tested.

2361.closed: Claretta, Storia della reggenza di Cristina di Francia vol. 1 (1868) pp. 660-661 summarises Maurizio's letter to Buschetti of 7 July 1640 and prints a passage of it in clear (footnote 1, cited 'Tutele e reggenze, mazzo 4'); date, sender, addressee and mazzo match the seal database's only 7/7/1640 Maurizio-Buschetti letter (did=1388, the cipher one), so its text was read in the 1860s, from a decipherment on or with the letter. Full text not printed.

2362.unvetted: No unit identified and no ciphertext shown. The only record is ASVe guide sdr 43087032, an inventory of 1991 titled "Lettere in cifra indirizzate prevalentemente ai Provveditori alle biave dal bailo di Costantinopoli (1589-1597) e dall'ambasciatore veneto in Spagna (1590)", whose own note says the fonds "Secreta, lettere in cifra ai provveditori alle biave" has no matching series in the database ("senza riscontro di SE relativa nel DB"). Archivi Nazionali fonds search 'biave' (Provveditori alle biave ca 42662931, Collegio alle biave, Senato/CX Biave) gives no busta number or description; in Venetian register titles 'lettere in cifra' often means the deciphered copies. known.py (biave, bailo di Costantinopoli, Provveditori alle biave, Secreta): nothing. Three web searches (biave + bailo + cifra; Guida generale Secreta lettere in cifra; ASVe bailo 1590 provisions): nothing. Needs the 1991 inventory and the busta number from ASVe, and a look at whether the pieces are ciphertext or decipherments.

Needs ASGe photos of the filza, or an item list, to locate the cipher letters.
